Bug_Title: DLS: Useless increment in return statement (DLS_DEAD_LOCAL_INCREMENT_IN_RETURN)
Bug_Details:
This statement has a return such as return x++; / return x--;.
A postfix increment/decrement does not impact the value of the expression,
so this increment/decrement has no effect.
Please verify that this statement does the right thing.
 return x++; return x--;
Bug_Explanation: This bug is caused by the use of a postfix increment operator in a return statement. The increment operator does not impact the value of the expression, so the increment has no effect. The return statement returns the original value of x, before the increment.
Trigger_Explanation: This test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method and asserting that the returned value is not equal to the initial value of x. This is because the return statement in the showBug method has a postfix increment operator, which doesn't impact the value of the expression, and the return statement returns the original value of x, before the increment.
